notes: Access: direct curl (requests) to robots.txt/homepage was blocked by DataDome (JS-challenge HTML returned, HTTP 200 with captcha page); switched to curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 which bypassed it cleanly for all subsequent fetches (tier 1, HTTP+HTML/JSON parse only, no browser needed). robots.txt: generic 'User-agent: *' Allow: / with Disallow only on /orchestration/, /api/, /cgi-bin/, /blog/wp-content/, /homepage; no Claude-specific (ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot) entry at all -> not blocked. Terrain (shopterrain.com) is a garden/outdoor-lifestyle brand (Anthropologie family) built on a Decor/Furniture/Garden/Gifts taxonomy; it has no bathroom fixtures, vanities, showers, baths, taps, toilets, or bathroom mirrors anywhere in its catalog. Tree source: fetched categories_sitemap.xml (273 URLs, complete list) and scanned for bath/spa/soap/vanity/mirror/towel/toilet/tumbler/toothbrush/caddy/shower/sink/faucet/bidet keywords, then cross-checked /explore-decor and /explore-gifts nav pages. Found exactly two genuine bathroom-accessory leaf listing pages (facet URLs with own canonical h1 + embedded JSON totalRecordCount, both present in the sitemap): (1) /decor?attributionProductType=Bathroom+Decor, h1 'Bathroom Decor', totalRecordCount:25, product slugs are bathroom accessories only (soap dishes, soap/lotion dispensers, toothbrush holders, marble/basalt/river-stone trays and tumblers, bath caddy) -> recorded under Bathroom per rule 13/17. (2) /gifts-spa-beauty?itemType=Soap+Dish+%26+Dispenser, h1 'Soap Trays + Dispensers', totalRecordCount:13, all 13 product slugs are a subset of the 25 in node (1) (confirmed by direct slug-list comparison) -> this is normal cross-facet multi-tagging (site's own traps note: parent/child are not always supersets, products get multi-tagged), not a same-URL duplicate, so both genuinely different URLs are kept as separate records per rule 28. Excluded from gifts-spa-beauty: Cleanser/Toner, Body Scrub/Body Soap, Serum, Body Moisturizer, Hand Lotion/Hand Soap, Skin Care, Vitamins & Supplements facets -- these are toiletries/skincare products, not bathroom fixtures/hardware/accessories, out of scope. No mirror, towel-rail, toilet, shower, bath, sink, faucet, bidet, vanity-cabinet, or bathroom-storage nodes exist anywhere on the site (search terms returned zero matching sitemap entries beyond the two recorded and the excluded spa/beauty facets). Cross-category dedup checked against cross_category_url_index.json for both recorded URLs: no hits (both null), so nothing routed to review as ALREADY EXTRACTED. No exclusions needed beyond the toiletries facets above.
